nights_target_sentence: The nights models predict nights directly. On the training folds a log target averaged 73.76 nights of error against 71.84 for the direct target, which is not a 2% improvement, so the log target was not used.
selection_reason: The lowest average error was $54.19 a night, from XGBoost. Ridge regression was $55.18, inside the 2% band (up to $55.28), and it is the simplest model in that band.
nights_selection_reason: The lowest average error was 69.0 nights, from Random forest. Linear regression was 69.3 nights, inside the 2% band (up to 70.4 nights), and it is the simplest model in that band.
nights_reason: The nights model did not clear the pre-set bar in every city. The bar was an average miss at least 10% lower than the local median nights, and an R² of at least 0.10. The app labels nights as a rough estimate.
